notice: Synthetic corpus. No customer, production or real project bytes, and no real organisation, address, person or project. Owner decision OD-17 rules the corpus synthetic-only; every record's provenance is 'synthetic' and no record is 'anonymized'.
text_extraction: Quotation offsets are into the text of a single page as produced by tools/fixtures/ar_corpus/pdfextract.py: runs grouped into lines by baseline, lines top to bottom, joined by a single newline. Every quotation lies wholly within one line, so any extractor that preserves line content resolves it identically. Every quotation was additionally resolved with pdfplumber, which shares no code with the writer.

rules.ENV-PDF: the input is a PDF file
rules.ENV-ENCRYPTED: the PDF is not encrypted or password-protected
rules.ENV-SIZE: the file is at most 26214400 bytes (25 MiB)
rules.ENV-PAGES: the document has at most 30 pages
rules.ENV-TEXT: every page carries extractable embedded text

composition.note: Negative-envelope documents are counted separately and are excluded from every finding denominator and from every gate that counts measurable documents, G4 included.

control_archetypes.other_object: the same attribute stated for a different, explicitly named object - a gatehouse, a substation, a neighbouring block
control_archetypes.scope_dependent: values that legitimately differ because they describe different scopes - a ground floor against a typical floor, an above-ground part against a basement
control_archetypes.identical_repeat: the same value restated identically on another page; two mentions of one attribute are not two values
control_archetypes.excluded_by_text: a value the surrounding text explicitly excludes from the comparison it would otherwise contradict
control_archetypes.superseded: a value the document explicitly withdraws, so it is history rather than a competing claim
control_archetypes.notation_variant: one value written two ways - thin space against none, м² against кв. м - identical to a reader, different to a string comparator
control_archetypes.placeholder_stem: prose carrying the stem of a placeholder word while recording a decision that has actually been made
control_archetypes.absence_by_scope: something genuinely absent from this document because another document owns it, which is not an unfilled field
control_archetypes.decided_alternative: an alternative mentioned and then explicitly rejected in favour of a stated choice
control_archetypes.sibling_filled: a filled value for a sibling of an attribute that is genuinely blank nearby, so the blank has to be distinguished from its neighbour
control_archetypes.tolerance_or_rounding: text that legitimises a small numeric divergence, so the divergence is declared rather than accidental
control_archetypes.class_notation: several class-like tokens that belong to different classification systems and are easy to conflate

documents.label: PC02-S01
documents.summary_ru: Семь страниц. Класс конструктивной пожарной опасности корпуса 1 назван дважды по-разному, и марка фасадных кассет оставлена незаполненной.

seeded_issues.why_seeded: Two sections of a real AR volume are often written by different people weeks apart, and the structural fire-hazard class is exactly the kind of attribute each restates independently. The wording is identical apart from the value, so the contradiction is unambiguous, while the same page range also carries the same class for a different object and a different class system for the same object - so finding it requires reading the subject of the sentence, not matching a pattern.

documents.label: PC02-S03
documents.summary_ru: Семь страниц. Тип кровли одного корпуса назван и плоским, и скатным, а толщина утеплителя покрытия оставлена прочерком.

seeded_issues.summary_ru: Кровля корпуса 3 описана как плоская с внутренним водостоком на странице 3 и как скатная с наружным водостоком на странице 6.
seeded_issues.why_seeded: Every other seeded contradiction in this corpus is numeric. This one is categorical, and a rate measured only on numbers would not generalize to the half of AR prose that carries no figures. It is also the contradiction with the largest professional consequence here, which is what makes it worth asking a reviewer whether the finding was useful.

documents.label: PC02-S04
documents.title_ru: Корпус 4. Вертикальный транспорт и высотные отметки
documents.summary_ru: Девять страниц с двумя заложенными расхождениями и явно отменённым третьим значением отметки, которое расхождением не является.

seeded_issues.summary_ru: Абсолютная отметка нуля корпуса 4 указана как 143,60 на странице 2 и как 143,80 на странице 7.
seeded_issues.why_seeded: A 200 mm disagreement in the datum is small enough to survive review and expensive enough to matter on site, which is exactly the profile of a finding worth paying for. The document also carries the datum of a neighbouring block and a third value it explicitly withdraws, so three numbers are in play and only one pair is a contradiction.

seeded_issues.summary_ru: Количество пассажирских лифтов корпуса 4 указано как два на странице 4 и как три на странице 8.
seeded_issues.why_seeded: Counts of the same equipment class in one building are a standard AR inconsistency. The wording is identical apart from the numeral, so the claim is unambiguous, while a goods lift in the same building offers the obvious wrong reconciliation - two plus one - which a careless reader would accept.

documents.summary_ru: Десять страниц. Этажность корпуса названа дважды по-разному, а назначение одного из встроенных помещений оставлено неопределённым.

seeded_issues.summary_ru: Этажность корпуса 5 указана как 12 этажей на странице 2 и как 14 этажей на странице 9.
seeded_issues.why_seeded: Storey count is the attribute most often restated in an AR volume and therefore most often restated wrongly. This one is planted directly beside the legitimate Russian distinction between этажность and количество этажей, which differ by the basement on purpose - so a model that treats every nearby number as the same attribute produces a false positive on the very next line while finding the real one.

seeded_issues.summary_ru: Назначение помещения 1.12 оставлено как «не определено» на странице 6.
seeded_issues.why_seeded: An explicitly undetermined field with no conventional placeholder token. It sits two pages from a filled sibling room and one page from a sentence carrying the уточн stem about a list that is complete, so both the recall and the precision sides of the placeholder category are exercised in one document.

negative_envelope_documents.label: PC02-N01
negative_envelope_documents.rule_description: the PDF is not encrypted or password-protected
negative_envelope_documents.description_ru: Двухстраничный PDF, защищённый паролем пользователя synthetic-user-pw и паролем владельца synthetic-owner-pw.
negative_envelope_documents.why_it_matters: A password-protected submission is the most common over-the-wall failure in practice. The observation is that the product says so, and does not report a page count it cannot have read.

negative_envelope_documents.label: PC02-N02
negative_envelope_documents.rule_description: every page carries extractable embedded text
negative_envelope_documents.description_ru: Двухстраничный PDF, каждая страница — растровое изображение без единого текстового оператора.
negative_envelope_documents.why_it_matters: The scanned-drawing case. PROTOTYPE_PROFILE.md section 7.1 forbids silently substituting OCR, so the only acceptable behaviour is an explicit refusal naming ENV-TEXT.

negative_envelope_documents.label: PC02-N03
negative_envelope_documents.rule_description: the file is at most 26214400 bytes (25 MiB)
negative_envelope_documents.description_ru: Корректный двухстраничный PDF, доведённый до размера свыше 25 МиБ одним несвязанным потоком-заполнителем.
negative_envelope_documents.why_it_matters: Size is the rule most likely to be checked late, after the bytes have already been read into memory. The fixture is genuinely oversized on disk rather than merely declared so.

negative_envelope_documents.label: PC02-N04
negative_envelope_documents.rule_description: the document has at most 30 pages
negative_envelope_documents.description_ru: PDF из 31 страницы, каждая с текстовым слоем: ровно на одну страницу больше предела.
negative_envelope_documents.why_it_matters: One page over the limit, because the interesting failure is the boundary rather than an obvious excess.
